item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a product shot for me. I've been thinking about how to present this and am probably overthinking it a little. The product is a scented candle, which is the thing I want the shot to feature. I want it to look premium.

dialog.agent:
Absolutely—a simple composition with soft lighting and a refined background can make the candle feel premium without overcomplicating it.

Do you have a photo of the candle you’d like me to use, or should I create a concept shot?

Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?
dialog.why: It asks whether to use a candle photo or create a concept shot, and where the image will be shown, then waits for the user’s choices.
dialog.user: Please create a concept shot, and I'll leave the platform and aspect ratio up to you. The container, palette, setting, and lighting are your call as well. I’m probably overthinking the presentation a little, but the main thing is that the scented candle looks premium.

dialog.agent:
I’ll keep it understated: an ivory ceramic candle, warm stone textures, and soft directional lighting.

Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?
dialog.why: It asks whether words should appear and requests the exact wording, then waits for the user’s choice.
dialog.user: The brand and label wording are your call, including whether any words appear on it at all. I’m happy to leave those details to you; the main thing for me is that the scented candle looks premium. I’m probably overthinking the presentation a little, which is why I’d rather let you make those choices.

turns.agent:
I settled on an understated concept: an unbranded ivory ceramic candle on warm travertine, with soft directional lighting and no distracting props.

**The image wasn’t generated** because Magic Hour reported insufficient credits. Once credits are available, I can use this direction to create the shot.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Premium scented candle concept product photograph, understated luxury editorial still life. One exquisite ivory ceramic candle vessel with a softly rounded cylindrical silhouette, thick rim, subtle finely textured matte glaze and creamy natural wax, a single cotton wick with a small elegant flame. Candle is the unmistakable hero, large in frame, placed slightly right of center on a warm honed travertine plinth. A matching ceramic lid rests quietly beside its base. Restrained palette of ivory, sand, oatmeal and pale warm stone. Seamless warm beige studio background with a subtle tonal gradient. Soft directional window light from the upper left shapes the vessel with luminous highlights and gentle deep shadows; delicate flame reflection at the inner rim. Low three-quarter camera viewpoint reveals the wax surface, realistic proportions, exquisite ceramic and stone material detail, art-directed high-end fragrance campaign photography, sophisticated spacious composition, shallow but controlled depth of field with the entire candle sharp. Calm, tactile, timeless and expensive. No branding, no label, no writing, no typography, no watermark, no extra candles, no flowers, no clutter.
